name: Cursor
description: What Cursor and its CLI do on this machine: the plan's included usage and when it renews, chats open now, usage and its value estimated at list prices, by day, project and model. Chats read from Cursor's own files; the plan's usage from Cursor's dashboard, once you allow it; nothing saved.

account.label: Read usage from your Cursor account
account.description: with Cursor.app's sign-in on this machine, the plan's usage and what each request was worth are read from cursor.com every few minutes; the sign-in goes only to Cursor and nothing is kept. Off until you allow it
